title: Kirkpatrick: metallic orbs worldwide, said at NASA panel

tellings.quote: Kurt Patrick, former director of Aeros said uh quote, "We're seeing metallic orbs, direct quote, making very interesting apparent maneuvers all over the world."

plain: Sean Kirkpatrick, the first director of the Pentagon's office for investigating UFO reports, is said to have told NASA's public UFO panel in 2023 that "we're seeing metallic orbs making very interesting apparent maneuvers all over the world." The writer Marik von Rennenkampff, a former government analyst, quotes those words on the show while debating a skeptic. He cites them because they would mean the top official on the subject admitted to unexplained objects seen worldwide.
